data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for on‑device authentication using biometrics, PIN, pattern or passcode.
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified API to check device authentication capabilities and to prompt the user for biometric or device‑level authentication. It abstracts platform‑specific implementations for Android, iOS, macOS and Windows. Errors are returned as structured LocalAuthException codes.
use_when: You need local, on‑device authentication without a backend
You want biometric, face, fingerprint or fallback PIN/passcode support across mobile and desktop
You require a simple API to check enrollment and authenticate the user
avoid_when: You need social or OAuth based sign‑in flows
strengths: Native biometric and device‑level authentication on multiple platforms
Fallback to PIN/pattern/passcode when biometrics unavailable
Clear error handling with LocalAuthException codes
weaknesses: Requires native setup and permissions per platform
data.setup_notes: Add local_auth and platform packages to pubspec, configure Android manifest (USE_BIOMETRIC permission), iOS Info.plist (NSFaceIDUsageDescription), and follow platform‑specific README links for additional steps.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Google OAuth sign‑in and works on web as well as mobile

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a full suite of authentication methods (email/password, social, anonymous) with server‑side token handling
